title: Not a did, but also not really happy with this one
text: Not a did, but also not really happy with this one. This is more of a mister than an evaporative cooler.  I do not see much overall cooling occurring, but it is nice in the stream of water mist.  There is a lot of humidity created, which I do not like.  It is highly portable, as advertised, and works well as a fan.  It is "okay", but another option could be much better.
